task_spec: Add in_window(ts, start, end): our windows are half-open. ts is in the window iff start <= ts < end (the end is EXCLUSIVE), so adjacent windows never double-count a boundary timestamp.

bugs.description: in_window uses start <= ts <= end (inclusive end), but the spec requires a half-open window with an EXCLUSIVE end (start <= ts < end). A ts exactly equal to end is wrongly counted as in-window and double-counted by the adjacent window. Inclusive bounds are a normal default; only the arbitrary half-open convention (spec only) makes <= wrong.

provenance.note: arbitrary rule lives ONLY in task_spec; not derivable from code or world knowledge
